description_en: Modifies a protocol service. You can use this operation to modify the description of the protocol service
description_zh: 修改一个协议服务，支持修改协议服务描述信息
name: ModifyProtocolService

parameters.help_en: The ID of the protocol service. You can obtain the ID by calling the CreateProtocolService (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cpfs/cpfsonecs/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-createprotocolservice-cpfs) operation after you create a protocol service, or by calling the DescribeProtocolService (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cpfs/cpfsonecs/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describeprotocolservice-cpfs) operation to query existing protocol services
parameters.help_zh: 协议服务 ID。调用 CreateProtocolService (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/cpfs/cpfsonecs/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-createprotocolservice-cpfs?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-111536.d_4_1_4_8_0.34022b00wNMcec&scm=20140722.H_2402280._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1) 接口创建协议服务后返回，或通过 DescribeProtocolService (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/cpfs/cpfsonecs/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describeprotocolservice-cpfs?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-111536.d_4_1_4_8_3.4707210a8yHZsX&scm=20140722.H_2402283._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1) 接口查询获取
parameters.name: protocol_service_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the protocol service.

Limits:

The description must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
The description must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The description can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
Spaces and other special characters are not allowed. Valid example: `My-Protocol-Service_01`
parameters.help_zh:
协议服务的描述信息。

限制：

长度为 2~128 个英文或中文字符。
必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以 `http://` 和 `https://` 开头。
可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
不允许空格及其他特殊字符，合规示例：`My-Protocol-Service_01`
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the modification request.
A dry run checks the validity of parameters and dependencies without actually modifying the instance or incurring fees.

Valid values:
true: Performs a dry run. The protocol service is not modified. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and business limits and dependencies are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the HTTP status code 200 is returned.
false (default): Performs a normal request. The protocol service is modified after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次修改请求执行预检。
预检操作会帮助您检查参数有效性、依赖条件等，并不会实际修改实例，也不会产生费用。

取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改协议服务。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制依赖条件。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回200 HttpCode。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接修改协议服务
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, and you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests.

The client token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同的请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

若用户未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
